raw_text: Mandiant Threat Intelligence Report: DPRK Lazarus Group Attributed to $230M WazirX Cryptocurrency Theft. Mandiant has attributed the WazirX cryptocurrency exchange breach to North Korean threat actor Lazarus Group (APT38) based on combined on-chain forensics, social engineering indicators, and infrastructure analysis. The attack used compromised LinkedIn profiles to deliver initial access malware to exchange employees. DPRK-affiliated accounts simultaneously conducted an information operation attributing the theft to insider fraud to delay attribution.
